## Scope check

This project deliberately avoids speculative options and abstractions (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)) — the simplest version that solves your actual, concrete problem is what we're after. If this is a bigger change, please open the issue before a PR so we can agree on the approach first.
